Comments
Grade   

The main issue with this letter is you don’t acknowledge that you are writing to the person who referred the patient:



You spend too much time giving initial symptoms when she arrived and not enough on treatment and recovery. That is what the reader will want. You don’t say that she is ‘responding well to treatment’

I think you can afford to summarise the details about initial symptoms on arrival more and give more detail about treatment. 


Purpose 2

Your introduction is unclear because of Grammar. Therefore, the purpose of the letter is unclear: 


Content 4

As I say above, you need more detail about treatment and recovery. The reader will already have a good idea about her symptoms on arrival. Summarise this more. 

Conciseness and clarity 6

This is good throughout except for the Introduction. 

Genre and Style  6

Again the word data is slightly inappropriate here as it sounds cold and overly scientific:


It makes you sound like you don’t care about the patient. Despite this, again I have given 6 of 7. 

Organisation and layout: 5

Generally clear. 


Language: 5

Again 5 and there are  number issues above. 

Introduction grammar and also we cannot use the Passive like this here:



You used the Object of the sentence. It should be: “The immunisation status of the family was discussed with the family.” 

C +
